text:
maria: Quick sync — ISV bridge POC (LangChain runner <-> Redwood gateway) passed staging smoke. Can we lock press/marketplace cadence?
aj: awesome! congrats team. what's the timeline for customer-facing demo?
kevin: mgmt wants a joint announcement week of Apr 12 if we can get legal signoff and a quote from SI partner. any blockers?
diana: I'll own press. need a short 2-paragraph blurb and 1 customer quote by Apr 8. can engineering provide a 2-min demo video and a one-pager on integration flow?
maria: engineering can do demo vid. AJ can you prod the runner folks for a quick screen capture? also need a one-pager that describes: auth flow, latency numbers, and marketplace listing steps.
aj: pinged runner eng in DM. they can record tomorrow. for latency numbers, rough p50/p95 from staging: 90ms / 210ms (seq len avg 128) — want me to include?
kevin: include those but mark as staging. marketing will annotate with "typical" and link to benchmarks page.
diana: yes, please mark staging. also we need embargo details. do partners want an embargoed joint blog + cloud marketplace listing + tweet?
maria: partner prefers embargoed blog + marketplace tile + joint webinar. embargo lifts Apr 12 10:00 PDT.
announce-bot: Reminder: create calendar invite for Apr 12 10:00 PDT for joint webinar prep (organizer: diana).
diana: thanks bot. I'll draft the blog and teaser. who can vet marketplace tile copy?
aj: I can review the technical bits. legal will handle partner logos / trademark approval.
kevin: SI partner (NorthStar Systems) needs a co-marketing checklist. items: logo approval, customer quote, webinar speaker, one-pager, partner case study timeline. Maria, can you coordinate?
maria: already on it. I shared a checklist spreadsheet: https://redwood.example/sheets/isv-bridge-checklist — please fill rows for your owners.
diana: marketing ask: provide a 2-line speaker bio for NorthStar and a short demo script (3 bullet steps).
aj: demo script (draft):
```
1) start convo with product-support agent prompt
2) show chaining via LangChain -> call outbound Redwood tool for embedding lookup
3) show fallback to smaller model + graceful degraded response
```
kevin: looks good. ops question: do we need a special billing SKU for marketplace usage metrics for the partner? finance flagged partner revenue share.
maria: finance on call Wed; I'll add billing SKU creation to the checklist.
diana: press note — can someone provide a short customer quote? if none, we can use partner quote placeholder, but customer makes announcement stronger.
aj: we have one internal early adopter (AcmeOps) willing to be quoted. I'll confirm with their PM today.
kevin: security check — ensure no customer data in demo video. scrub logs and use synthetic data.
aj: noted. will scrub.
maria: engineering blocker: the bridge currently uses a temporary API key flow for the orchestration demo. must swap to oauth client creds before public demo. estimate 48hrs.
diana: ok timeline still works if swapped by Apr 8. pls update checklist when done.
maria: will do.
diana: marketing will prepare the embargoed press release draft and a short social thread. tagging creative for assets.
kevin: one more ask — product wants to include a small FAQ tile on marketplace around supported models and billing. aj, can you draft 3 FAQs?
aj: yes: "Which models supported?" "How is billing calculated?" "What happens during capacity failover?" I'll draft answers.
diana: perfect. after legal approves logos and copy, i'll send to partner for final signoff on Apr 9.
maria: quick deployment note for eng-oncall: when we flip to oauth, watch for 401 spikes and ensure fallback to dedicated routing. put a temporary alert on the route.
announce-bot: Deploy scheduled: oauth-credentials-swap -> Apr 7 03:00 UTC. Owners: aj, maria.
aj: got it. I'll be on-call.
diana: timeline recap: Apr 7 oauth swap, Apr 8 final assets & demo video, Apr 9 partner signoff, Apr 12 embargo lift + joint announcement.
kevin: ok, I'll update the release tracker and tell sales go/no-go by Apr 10.
maria: any final risks?
aj: risk: marketplace listing approvals sometimes take 3-5 business days with cloud marketplace — flagged to partner to submit earlier.
diana: I'll prep a "fast-track" notes packet for marketplace PMs.
maria: thanks all. will post checklist updates.
diana: thank you — big win if we hit this. :tada:
maria: :rocket:
